Hurricane Sandy was not a hurricane when it hit the US

When did a hurricane last come ashore near you?

From Virginia Beach to Ocean City, it hasn't happened once in records going back to 1851. https://t.co/QpC3O3BGz3

A lot of y'all keep asking when it finally cools off. Find yourself on the map.

A lot of the North drops to freezing Saturday or Sunday morning, and the snow is mostly up in the mountains out West. https://t.co/J9RMziBWy2

If you live inside the white line, your power grid is on an emergency alert today. That's this October heat, plus a lot of power plants down for fall maintenance.

You don't have to do anything. https://t.co/bbXjMqmXTW
